The '''Outer Rim Travel Services''' was an agency. [[Jarmat Dav're]], under the alias "Renak Tivs," contracted the agency to find a remote getaway destination. The Outer Rim Travel Services found an [[Jarmat's Island Hideaway|island]] on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which Dav're rented for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
